properties.content:

Nearest City: Jacksonville, FL

Incident Type: AIRCRAFT
Material: JET FUEL: JP-8
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: 125TH FIGHTER WING
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 30.482111, -81.702247 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 500 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** F-15 WAS AT 15 MILE FINAL WHEN HE HAD AN UNCOMMANDED FUEL VENTING EMERGENCY. HE CONTACTED SOF AT 10 MILE FINAL WITH HIS FUEL STATE (9000#) AND WAS INFORMED TO FLY HIS JET FIRST, AND LAND SAFELY. HE LANDED WITHOUT INCIDENT AND CLEARED OFF AT TAXIWAY G WHERE HE WAS MET BY JFRD FIRST, FOLLOWED BY 125TH FW FIRE DEPARTMENT ASSETS QUICKLY AFTER. ONCE CLEAR OF THE RUNWAY, HE RAN THE CHECKLIST OVER THE RADIO WITH THE SOF AND MANAGED TO STOP THE VENTING. SOF INSTRUCTED THE FIRE CHIEF TO CHECK FOR HOT BRAKES AND TO PLAN ON SHUTTING DOWN ONCE PINNED UP. FIRE RESCUE ASSETS SAFELY PINNED AND SHUT A/C 146 DOWN ON TAXIWAY G. ESTIMATE THAT APPROX 500# OF JP8 WAS VENTED ONTO RUNWAY 08 AND TAXIWAY G DURING THE EVENT.
